zh.title: 《唐诗的回响》伦敦音乐会｜以制作支持跨文化表达
zh.summary: 让以唐诗为主题的音乐演出获得相应的制作支持，以现场协调服务不同文化背景的艺术表达与交流。
zh.preview: 当中文诗意由多国歌唱家演绎，制作的任务是为艺术呈现提供实际支撑。本案围绕音乐会需求参与统筹与演出支持，让文化主题落实于现场。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与音乐会制作统筹与演出支持，工作围绕节目呈现所需的实际安排展开。
zh.context: 《唐诗的回响》新春音乐会在伦敦举行，由中国对外文化交流协会主办。多国歌唱家以中文演绎根据唐诗创作的音乐作品，诗歌与音乐共同构成跨文化交流的载体。

narrativeSections.heading: 以表演承载文化内容
narrativeSections.text: 诗歌的语言与音乐的表达共同进入现场，艺术家成为文化内容的传递者。这类项目的制作价值，在于为表演提供适当支持，让活动主题拥有具体的舞台呈现。

narrativeSections.heading: 统筹围绕艺术呈现展开
narrativeSections.text: 我们的参与集中于制作统筹配合与演出支持。两项工作以音乐会需求为参照，将活动安排与表演所需的执行工作放在一起考虑。

narrativeSections.heading: 文化项目需要可落地的协作
narrativeSections.text: 跨文化主题最终仍需通过具体演出与观众相遇。本案的价值落在这一执行层面：为文化节目在伦敦的呈现提供制作支持，让交流目标有实际的现场载体。

deliverables: 围绕音乐会需求的制作统筹配合
服务节目呈现的演出支持
outcomes: 交付音乐会制作统筹配合与演出支持，服务唐诗音乐作品的现场呈现。
项目参与将文化主题与演出执行联系起来，为伦敦文化交流场景提供实际支持。

en.title: Echoes of Tang Poetry | Supporting Cultural Expression in London
en.summary: Production coordination and performance support gave a poetry-led concert practical backing, serving a cultural exchange expressed through music.
en.preview: With singers from different countries performing in Chinese, the production task was to support the artistic presentation. Our contribution centred on the practical work around the concert.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to production coordination and performance support, organising its involvement around the concert’s practical presentation needs.
en.context: The Echoes of Tang Poetry New Year concert took place in London, organised by the China International Culture Association. Singers from different countries performed Chinese-language works based on Tang poetry, bringing poetry and music together as a form of cultural exchange.

narrativeSections.heading: Culture carried through performance
narrativeSections.text: Poetic language and musical expression meet on stage, with the artists carrying the programme. Production has a supporting role: providing practical backing so the cultural theme can take a live form.

narrativeSections.heading: Coordination around the concert
narrativeSections.text: Our involvement centred on production coordination and performance support. Both took the concert’s needs as their reference, relating event arrangements to the practical work required around the presentation.

narrativeSections.heading: Making an exchange possible on site
narrativeSections.text: A cross-cultural programme ultimately reaches people through a specific performance. This contribution sat at that practical level, supporting the concert’s presentation in London and giving the cultural occasion an operational foundation.

deliverables: Production coordination support around the concert’s needs
outcomes: Production coordination and performance support served the live presentation of works based on Tang poetry.
The contribution provided practical support for a cultural exchange occasion in London.
